name: Atmospheric Entry Flight Mechanics
summary: Flight mechanics of vehicles entering a planetary atmosphere: ballistic and lifting entry, deceleration, heating and entry corridors.

Planetary atmospheres: Earth, Mars, Venus, Titan, gas giants
